architectureDecisions: D1 — The supported v1 distribution is one single-tenant OCI/container profile with a CLI-first control surface. Kubernetes tenancy, multi-node HA and an operator web UI are explicitly deferred; they require separate measured product need.

D2 — DELIVERY_RELEASE_MANIFEST_V1 is the normative distribution identity. It binds source/release version, linux/amd64 image content ID, required delivery-image.tar SHA-256, pinned Node-24 base-image identity, state-schema compatibility version, SCM=GitHub, delivered runtime/profile refs, config-schema digest and reference-seed digest. A Docker tag is only a local locator and can never satisfy identity/currentness by itself.

D3 — The supported v1 runtime is linux/amd64 Node 24 inside the container because repository kernel CI executes on Node 24. The release image contains every runtime prerequisite needed by the delivered BB-070/BB-072 adapters; the clean operator host requires only a Docker/Compose-compatible engine with `docker image load` and `docker compose run --pull never`, plus network access for the configured SCM/provider. Host Node, npm, Git and a repository checkout are not prerequisites.

D4 — The supported operator CLI commands are doctor, configure, run, status, cancel, backup, restore and upgrade-check. They compose BB-070 lifecycle and BB-072 operations APIs; the CLI is an adapter/control surface and owns no alternate lifecycle or acceptance state.

D5 — Configuration is schema-validated and split from secrets. The committed config example contains no credentials; provider/SCM secrets enter only through named environment/file secret inputs. doctor fails with actionable typed errors for missing credentials, unsupported runtime, unreachable SCM/provider prerequisites and incompatible persisted state.

D6 — Clean install is self-contained: the release bundle must include delivery-image.tar, digest-pinned release/config/reference-seed manifests and the runbook. Installation verifies the archive hash, loads the image, verifies the loaded image content ID, and runs Compose with pull disabled. A registry may later mirror the same image but is not part of BB-073 acceptance and cannot be a hidden prerequisite.

D7 — Upgrade is allowed only after upgrade-check validates state-schema compatibility and either no ACTIVE/RECOVERY_REQUIRED attempt exists or the exact delivered compatibility contract permits continuation. Otherwise the operator must quiesce/cancel/reconcile first. No in-place best-effort migration is allowed from an unknown state.

D8 — Rollback uses the exact previous OCI digest plus its compatible state snapshot/release manifest. If the current persisted schema is not rollback-compatible, rollback requires restoring the pre-upgrade backup; unsupported downgrade fails closed.

D9 — OpenHands software-agent-sdk v1.49.6 is not repackaged as a second product; the distribution consumes the exact BB-070/BB-069 delivered runtime profile. Langfuse v4.46.0 remains optional observability infrastructure from BB-072 and is not required for install/health.

D10 — Worker preflight requires BB-070 and BB-072 DONE and binds their exact lifecycle/operator/config/state compatibility outputs. Any mismatch in control commands, canonical data roots or compatibility semantics is PLAN_INPUT_CONTRADICTION.

expectedDependencyOutputs: BB-070 DONE: exact supported product-entry/lifecycle/reference-product API and release identity consumed by the distribution.
BB-072 DONE: exact operator CLI/API, canonical store roots, backup/restore contract and state-schema compatibility metadata consumed by install/upgrade/rollback.

implementationSlices: S0 — Bind DELIVERY_CONTRACT.dependencyBind: require BB-070/BB-072 DONE, resolve exact implementation-result/judgment/consolidated refs, generate `packages/delivery-cli/src/dependency-adapter.js`, and prove its exports are exactly lifecycle.run + operations.{doctor,status,cancel,backup,restore,upgradeCheck}; mismatch stops with PLAN_INPUT_CONTRADICTION.

S1 — Build contract materialization: generate and commit `package-lock.json` with the declared lock-only command, create `distribution/reference-seed.json`, implement DELIVERY_BUILD_IDENTITY_V1 + DELIVERY_RELEASE_MANIFEST_V1 in `packages/delivery-cli/src/release.js`, and bind sourceSha/workspaceLockDigest/configSchemaDigest/stateSchemaCompatibilityVersion before image build.

S2 — CLI contract: implement `config.js`, `commands.js`, `index.js`, and `bin/exharness-delivery.mjs` for exactly doctor/configure/run/status/cancel/backup/restore/upgrade-check. Every command calls only dependency-adapter ports; tests must fail if code reaches canonical stores directly.

S3 — Image contract: implement `distribution/Dockerfile` for linux/amd64 Node 24, copy exact candidate root package metadata + lock + `packages/**`, run `npm ci --omit=dev`, use non-root entrypoint `node packages/delivery-cli/bin/exharness-delivery.mjs`, build locally, and inspect the resulting imageContentId for the external release manifest.

S4 — Bundle contract: implement `scripts/delivery/build-release.mjs --mode build|verify`; build mode emits only compose.yaml, config schema/example, release-manifest.json, delivery-image.tar and runbook, hashes every file, and records imageContentId/archive digest; verify mode succeeds from that directory alone and rejects build sections, registry dependency, digest mismatch or undeclared files.

S5 — Clean-install contract: `bb-073-probe.mjs --mode clean-install` creates an empty host dir, copies only bundle bytes, verifies digests, loads delivery-image.tar, matches imageContentId, supplies documented config/secrets, then runs doctor -> BB-070 reference run -> status with `docker compose run --pull never --rm`; any checkout/npm/host-Node/registry pull/NOT_RUN/missing accepted outcome ref fails AC-1.

S6 — Migration contract: exercise typed MISSING_CREDENTIAL, UNSUPPORTED_RUNTIME and INCOMPATIBLE_STATE failures pre-mutation; persist pre-upgrade backup, verify target bundle/image, allow only compatible quiescent upgrade, block ACTIVE/RECOVERY_REQUIRED without explicit compatibility, then roll back via exact prior imageContentId/release manifest and restore backup when downgrade compatibility is absent.

S7 — Final integrity + Living truth: run CLI/distribution/package/repository checks, scan bundle/Dockerfile/compose for checkout paths, secrets, build sections, registry dependency and mutable-image authority, then update `docs/living/system/state.md` + supported profile runbook with exact install, state, failure, upgrade and rollback boundaries.
